howToExport: In online banking, open the account's activity and choose Download or Export.
Pick Quicken (.QFX), Microsoft Money or OFX: they're all the same family of format. If QuickBooks (.QBO) is offered, you can import that directly.
Drop the file here: transactions, account number and ending balance are read from it.
Choose your bank in the .QBO settings and download.
knownQuirks: A .QFX file carries Quicken's bank ID, and Quicken and QuickBooks can use different IDs for the same bank, so pick your bank again for the .QBO file.
The bank's own transaction IDs (FITID) are kept by default, so QuickBooks still recognises transactions it imported earlier from the bank's own files.
Dates are read as the calendar day written in the file and never shifted by the time zone the bank adds after them.
Files declared CHARSET:1252 are read as Windows-1252, and escaped characters such as & are decoded before the .QBO file is written.
